brief: Batched triage of Octave's issues, and #221's stale plan comment.
tradeoff: Nothing given up; viewers gain a stated reason and possibly surround sound.
entry: #296 becomes JS-180 (Octave Web's verifier-bound one-time code, after JS-039, waiting for an Octave Web build). JS-039 is not widened; its Refine keeps tokens and reusable codes out of URLs and makes JS-180 a form of the same handoff. #295 becomes JS-181 at 34, observed against Jellyfin 12.4 first. #221 is closed as wontfix under D-089 and D-090. JS-181 takes 34, JS-178 35, JS-039 36, JS-180 37, JS-179 38, and later tasks move down two.
